_about: Course content for the Dive With Jimmy site. Edit here, then run: python3 src/build.py. Text and facts come from divewithjimmy.com (Nov 2026), checked against SSI (divessi.com) and BSAC (bsac.com). See COURSE-AUDIT.md for every change.

categories.name: Learn to scuba
categories.blurb: Your first breaths underwater, through to a certification you can use anywhere in the world.

categories.name: Snorkel & freediving
categories.blurb: No heavy kit. Learn to snorkel and freedive safely on a single breath.

categories.name: Continue diving
categories.blurb: Build experience and earn SSI's Specialty Diver, Advanced Open Water and Master Diver ratings.

categories.name: Specialty courses

courses.lede: Your first step into the world of scuba diving.
body: In your Try Scuba Diving session you'll get an introduction to the kit, learn basic hand signals and then try it out in the water. The session is in confined water with a small group, so you can enjoy those first unforgettable breaths underwater.
We take things nice and slowly so you feel calm and confident. At the end you'll receive your certificate, and we're sure you'll be excited to book your next course!
We run this experience during our pool time on Tuesday evenings.
courses.inc: Equipment hire, pool entry, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: Learn the skills and knowledge to dive to 12 metres with an SSI professional.
body: A great way to explore the underwater world more fully as you try diving. On completion you'll be qualified to dive with an SSI professional, anywhere in the world, to 12 metres for 6 months.
The whole course can be credited towards Scuba Diver or Open Water Diver if you continue within 6 months.
courses.inc: Equipment hire, pool entry, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: The perfect foundation to become a confident, safe diver.
body: You'll learn everything you need to scuba dive in open water to 12 metres with an SSI professional. The course is made up of half the elements of the full Open Water Diver course.
We recommend it for 10 to 15 year olds. At 16 we can upgrade you to Open Water Diver easily: you just complete the remaining academic and confined water sessions, plus two open water training dives.
It can also be combined with the SSI Dry Suit Diving course if you'd like to stay warmer on your dives.
courses.inc: All learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: The globally recognised certification, and the best way to begin a lifetime of diving.
body: Training combines e-learning with in-water practice to give you the skills, knowledge and experience to become truly comfortable underwater.
When you qualify you'll be able to dive with an equally or more qualified buddy, in conditions like those you trained in (or better), to 18 metres.
Enriched Air Nitrox is included as standard.
courses.inc: Learning materials, pool entry, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 2 days of open water training, or 3 if you opt out of pool sessions. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: In-water training days for BSAC members working through their diver grades.
body: Training days to help BSAC members work towards or complete their diver grade training, with Dive With Jimmy as your BSAC centre.
Get in touch with what you're working towards and we'll put together the right sessions.
facts: BSAC members in diver grade training

courses.lede: For anyone with a passion to discover the underwater world.
body: You'll learn to snorkel safely, choose and use your equipment, and master the skills while building your confidence. Led by Emma.
You don't need to be a strong swimmer and there's no minimum age. You just need to be comfortable in the water, able to keep yourself afloat, and ready for the adventure of a lifetime.
We run this course during our pool time on Tuesday evenings.
courses.inc: All equipment hire and instructor time.

courses.lede: Discover the underwater world without carrying heavy scuba equipment.
body: Freediving is the purest form of diving, and there are so many opportunities to freedive in the UK and around the world. This experience shows you some of the skills freedivers use to explore under the sea.
We run it during our pool time on Tuesday evenings. It takes about 90 minutes.
Already tried freediving? Take the next step with SSI Basic Freediver.
courses.inc: All equipment hire and instructor time.

courses.lede: Your first step into the peaceful, exhilarating world of freediving.
body: This entry-level course gives you the skills to freedive safely with a buddy to five metres. When you finish you'll earn the SSI Basic Freediver certification.
We run it during our pool time on Tuesday evenings, over several weeks.
facts: Online programme and poolside breath workshop
courses.inc: All learning materials, equipment and instructor time.

courses.lede: A recognition rating for completing 2 specialties and 12 logged dives.
body: Our Specialty Diver package gets you the courses and dives you need to earn this rating.
courses.inc: All learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 day of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Get the skills and experience to dive the world's best dive sites.
body: Whatever your passion, there's an SSI specialty for it, with over 20 to choose from. Complete enough specialties and you'll automatically earn the Specialty Diver, Advanced Open Water Diver and Master Diver ratings.
For Advanced Open Water we recommend Nitrox, Computer, Deep and Dry Suit. If you already have one of those, Night & Limited Visibility is a great choice for UK diving.
courses.inc: All learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 2 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: SSI's top recreational rating: 50 logged dives, 4 specialties and Diver Stress & Rescue.
body: Our Master Diver package is built around the courses and dives you enjoy most, or those you need for the next steps in your diving.
facts: Open Water Diver and React Right (or equivalents)
Online programme + 2 classroom sessions (depending on course)
courses.inc: 4 specialty courses, Diver Stress & Rescue, equipment hire, instructor time, breathing gases (for student and instructor) and any dives needed to reach 50 logged dives.

courses.lede: Haven't dived in the last 12 months? Refresh your skills in the pool.
body: A chance to review and practise the scuba skills you've learned along the way. It's a great idea to book this before you go on holiday, so you're all set to dive while you're away.
courses.inc: Learning materials, all equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 pool session.

courses.lede: Reach the dive sites you can only get to by boat.
body: This course takes you away from the shore and gives you the skills and confidence to dive from a boat, from small craft to week-long liveaboards in remote places.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: Get the most from the most important piece of kit you own.
body: We believe a dive computer is essential, and this course makes you completely at home with yours. It improves your dive safety and makes planning and running dives easier.
Available as a bundle with Enriched Air Nitrox, Decompression Diving or Deep Diving.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: Learn to plan and dive safely to 40 metres.
body: Using your dive computer and gas calculations, you'll learn to explore the underwater world at greater depths.
This specialty is a prerequisite for some advanced training, so it's worth booking early. It's available as a bundle with Enriched Air Nitrox and/or Computer Diving for extra time at depth.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 day of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Dive to 40 metres with limited decompression, up to 15 minutes.
body: Explore deeper sites and larger wrecks without the limits of traditional no-decompression diving. You'll use your recreational kit with a single decompression cylinder, and learn your computer's advanced features: gas switching, gas integration, time-to-reserve and time-to-surface.
Take advantage of our Decompression Diving bundle, which includes SSI Deep Diving and Enriched Air Nitrox.
facts: Open Water Diver with Deep Diving and Enriched Air Nitrox 40 (or equivalent)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 2 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Learn to prevent accidents, carry out rescues and give emergency care.
body: This course helps you protect yourself and other divers. It's one of the most important skill sets you can have.
Combine it with SSI React Right to be able to carry out a rescue and give the right first aid.
facts: Open Water Diver, physically able to complete the skills, and current O2 Provider, First Aid and CPR training (within 2 years)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 2 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Whizz around underwater on a scooter and cover more ground on every dive.
body: Learn to plan and run dives with a diver propulsion vehicle (DPV), keep in touch with your buddy, and stay in control of your equipment. This course qualifies you to dive with a DPV to 30 metres.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 day of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Stay warm and make UK diving far more comfortable.
body: A dry suit opens up so many more destinations, and keeps you warm on multi-dive days. You'll learn to use the specialised equipment, its benefits, and how to handle the emergencies unique to dry suit diving.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 day of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Learn more about your favourite underwater animal or ecosystem.
body: There are so many ecology specialties to choose from, there's something for everyone. Pick one, or four! They can all be completed online at any time, and the open water sessions are optional.
Ecology specialties are open to qualified snorkel divers and scuba divers.
facts: Snorkel Diver, or Referral Diver for scuba

courses.lede: More bottom time, shorter surface intervals and better safety margins.
body: Nitrox means more time diving and less time waiting. You can learn to dive with Enriched Air Nitrox of 32% or 40%.
Available as a bundle with Computer Diving and Deep Diving.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 day of open water training if you choose the diving package. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Choose the right kit, then keep it working at its best.
body: Choosing equipment is one of the biggest decisions you'll make. Learn how to pick the right gear, and how to store and maintain it for the best performance and longest life.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: Learn to blend nitrox and helium-based trimix safely.
body: Open to divers and non-divers alike, this course teaches the maths, physics and gas blending software behind every fill. Perfect if you want to understand how we make your nitrox and trimix.
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases.

courses.lede: Dive safely and comfortably without a designated buddy.
body: Gain the knowledge and skills to dive solo using redundant gas supplies.
facts: Open Water Diver and Diver Stress & Rescue, plus at least 5 dives each in Deep, Navigation and Night & Limited Visibility
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 2 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Find your way underwater with a compass and natural navigation.
body: Learn to estimate distances, leave and return to a set point, and use navigation patterns. These skills sharpen your observation and help you get the most out of every dive.
Available as a bundle with Night & Limited Visibility.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 day of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Become a safe, confident diver at night and in low visibility.
body: Learn how to enter and exit the water, use specialised equipment and communicate easily with your buddy when you can't see far. A great course for UK diving.
Available as a bundle with Navigation.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 day of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Buoyancy is the key to every good dive. Master it.
body: Learn advanced buoyancy skills and techniques so you can get it right quickly in every situation. It sets you up for more enjoyable diving, and is the perfect partner for Photo & Video.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, pool entry, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 2 pool sessions. Extra sessions are chargeable.

courses.lede: Bring your dives home to share with friends and family.
body: Shooting underwater brings challenges you don't get on land. Learn the techniques to use your camera well while protecting the environment around you.
Available as a bundle with Perfect Buoyancy.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, pool entry, equipment hire (excluding camera), instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 2 pool sessions. Extra sessions are chargeable.

courses.lede: SSI's emergency first response course.
body: Get the training and knowledge to act as a first responder in a medical emergency, through a mix of lessons and practical scenarios.
Available as a bundle with Diver Stress & Rescue.
courses.inc: Learning materials and instructor time.

courses.lede: Understand the underwater world and its effects on your body.
body: This specialty is required for most SSI professional programmes and some Extended Range programmes. It's available online, so you can earn it from home.
When you complete it you'll be halfway to the SSI Divemaster rating.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials and instructor time.

courses.lede: Jimmy would agree: some of the best dives in the world are wrecks.
body: Wrecks are full of history and marine life, and Jimmy loves finding out the story behind each vessel. This course teaches you to dive wrecks to 30 metres safely and confidently, with academic and confined water sessions plus non-penetration dives around wrecks and artificial reefs.
facts: Open Water Diver (Referral Diver to start)
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 1 day of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Take your wreck diving to the next level with limited penetration.
body: Plan and carry out limited penetration, no-decompression dives in daylight, to a maximum depth of 30 metres or a linear distance of 40 metres.
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 2 days of open water training (1 day for upgrades). Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Have a go on a twinset and take your first step into technical diving.
body: See the benefits a twinset offers recreational and technical divers alike, including longer dives. We'll teach you the basics of setting it up and using it underwater.
courses.inc: Equipment, pool entry, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: Sharpen your buoyancy, trim, finning and team skills in a workshop setting.
body: For recreational and technical divers who want to improve their advanced diving skills. Learn more about the diving system you use, and build on your basics to master buoyancy, trim, finning, positioning and communication.
All in-water sessions are in a pool or confined water, shallower than 12 metres. Available on single cylinder, twinset or CCR.
courses.inc: Equipment, pool entry, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: A thorough introduction to decompression diving with nitrox.
body: A stand-alone programme or a stepping stone to Extended Range Trimix, teaching the foundation skills for all technical programmes.
Using a twinset, you'll plan and carry out limited decompression dives to 40 metres, and learn to use gases up to 100% oxygen for decompression. Can be completed on a single cylinder or twinset.
Hire kit is available, but for the most benefit we recommend configuring your own.
facts: Open Water Diver, Deep Diving and Enriched Air Nitrox 40 (or equivalent)
courses.inc: Equipment, pool entry, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 4 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: The start of your journey to becoming an accomplished tech diver.
body: Using a twinset, you'll plan and carry out decompression dives to 45 metres using trimix, with nitrox mixes up to 100% oxygen for decompression.
You'll qualify to dive to 45m on gas mixes with a maximum END of 30m and up to 25 minutes of decompression. Can be completed on a single cylinder or twinset.
Hire kit is available, but for the most benefit we recommend configuring your own.
facts: Open Water Diver, Deep Diving and Enriched Air Nitrox 40 (or equivalent)
courses.inc: Equipment, pool entry, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 4 days of open water training (2 for upgrades). Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Unlimited decompression dives on mixed gas to 60 metres.
body: Building on Extended Range Trimix, this programme takes you beyond the no-decompression limit by increasing depth and duration. Using a twinset, you'll learn to independently plan and carry out unlimited decompression dives on mixed gas.
You'll qualify to dive to 60m on normoxic mixes, with up to 60 minutes of decompression using two hyperoxic mixes.
Hire kit is available, but for the most benefit we recommend configuring your own.
facts: Extended Range, Full Cave or Technical Wreck Diving (or equivalent)
70, including 20 deeper than 30m and 10 with staged decompression on one gas (excluding training)
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 5 days of open water training (3 for upgrades). Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Quality over quantity: the perfect start to technical diving.
body: Our combined BSAC Twin-set Diver and Accelerated Decompression Procedures (ADP) course gives you the knowledge, skills and confidence to carry out decompression dives, using vital tools such as dive planning, choosing the best mix for the depth, and kit set-up.
Completing both makes you a BSAC Advanced Twin-set Diver, able to plan dives to 40m using the gases you're certified for, with deco gases up to 80% nitrox.
facts: BSAC Sports Diver with 35m depth and nitrox training (or equivalent), plus 20 dives since Sports Diver including 30m experience
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 3 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.
courses.extra: Open water site entry and/or boat fees.

courses.n: BSAC Combined Sports & Explorer Mixed Gas
courses.lede: Trimix diving to 50m, then 60m with a travel gas, in one course.
body: Theory, confined water and build-up dives, learning to use a travel gas to support diving with normoxic trimix, finishing with a qualifying 60m dive.
When you qualify you'll be able to plan and dive on trimix to 60m using a twinset and two stage cylinders.
You should be proficient at deeper diving, with 30 or more logged dives between 30m and 50m, and have dived to 30m or deeper in the 4 weeks before the course.
facts: BSAC Sports Diver (35m) and Twinset & ADP (or equivalent). If you're not a BSAC Dive Leader, we recommend Oxygen Administration and Practical Rescue Management (or equivalent)
60, with evidence of dives between 30m and 50m in the 4 weeks before the course
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).
courses.extra: Open water site entry and/or boat fees.
courses.price: Sports Mixed Gas £1,350 · Explorer Mixed Gas £1,500 · SMG to XMG upgrade £1,250

courses.lede: Your gateway to a silent underwater world.
body: A captivating introduction to closed circuit rebreathers. Leave the noisy bubbles behind and explore in near silence, without disturbing the marine life around you.
Available on the AP Diving Inspiration CCR.
courses.inc: Learning materials, equipment, pool entry, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: No-decompression rebreather diving to 30 metres on the AP Inspiration.
body: This course introduces self-sufficiency and redundancy on a closed circuit rebreather. Become completely self-sufficient with SSI's training techniques, and learn rebreather dive planning, in-water skills, problem solving and emergency management.
You'll get a thorough grounding in pre-dive checks, assembly and how to deal with potential failures.
facts: Open Water Diver, Enriched Air Nitrox and Deep Diving (or equivalent)
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 4 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.lede: Decompression rebreather diving on a trimix diluent.
body: Building on CCR Diving, this programme increases depth and duration, introduces decompression and adds more complex skills. Training is on the AP Inspiration, using trimix as the breathing gas to reduce gas density and improve safety.
Hire kit is available, but for the most benefit we recommend configuring your own.
facts: Option 1: 30 extended range dives (5 with decompression, 25+ hours), Enriched Air Nitrox 40, Deep Diving and Extended Range Nitrox. Option 2: CCR Diving and 30 CCR hours on the unit
6 (at least 480 minutes); 2 on trimix for upgrades
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 5 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.

courses.n: SSI XR CCR Technical Extended Range (60m Trimix)
courses.lede: Unlimited decompression rebreather dives to 60 metres.
body: Takes the skills of an extended range rebreather diver and adds more complex scenarios for safer diving at greater depths and durations. Training is on the AP Inspiration, using a trimix diluent and up to three bailout cylinders.
Hire kit is available, but for the most benefit we recommend configuring your own.
facts: CCR Extended Range plus the logged dives below
50 CCR dives (50+ hours), 25 on this unit, 10 deeper than 30m with staged decompression (excluding training)
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor), and 4 days of open water training. Extra days are chargeable.
courses.extra: Open water site entry and overnight accommodation.

courses.lede: Go further inside shipwrecks than ever before.
body: Plan and carry out wreck penetration dives within the daylight zone, shallower than 40 metres. You'll learn specialised wreck equipment, gas management and buddy team skills for safe penetration.
Hire kit is available, but for the most benefit we recommend configuring your own.
facts: Open Water Diver and Extended Range Foundations (twinset), or equivalent. For XR CCR Wreck: also 20 dives and 30 hours on the unit
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: Everything you need for complex wreck penetration dives.
body: Using sidemount, twinset or rebreather, you'll develop high-level buoyancy control, finning techniques, line laying, use of lights, and lost line, lost light and lost diver procedures.
A challenging, rewarding certification that pushes your technical skills to the limit.
facts: Advanced Open Water, Diver Stress & Rescue, and Extended Range Wreck or Cavern (or equivalent). For CCR: also CCR Extended Range and 100 hours on the unit
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: The first step towards becoming a professional diver.
body: Learn to lead certified divers safely in a range of environments and conditions. Through dive briefings, site evaluations and leading dives, you'll quickly become a confident Dive Guide, and can begin working as a professional.
facts: Open Water Diver, Diver Stress & Rescue, Navigation, Night & Limited Visibility, Deep Diving
courses.inc: All learning materials, equipment hire, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: The first step on the SSI professional ladder.
courses.list_title: As an SSI Divemaster you can
list: Act as a certified assistant on all SSI recreational scuba courses
Assist on open water training dives, taking 2 students on excursion dives
Register for Ecology Specialty Instructor courses
Enrol on an SSI Instructor Training Course
list2: At least 60 logged dives, totalling over 40 hours
Pass the Science of Diving exam
Pass all requirements and evaluations in the instructor manual
Complete at least 2 open water dives
facts: Open Water Diver and Diver Stress & Rescue, plus 5 logged dives each in Deep, Navigation and Night & Limited Visibility
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: Start teaching, as part of SSI's Instructor Training Course.
courses.list_title: As an SSI Assistant Instructor you can
list: Teach Try Scuba, Scuba Skills Update and Perfect Buoyancy
Teach Open Water Diver academic and pool/confined water sessions
Complete online upgrades for Computer Diving, Marine Ecology and SSI Explorer Specialty Instructor
Qualify as a Specialty Instructor in some courses
Go on to complete the Instructor Training Course
list2: Complete sections 1–6 of the Instructor Training Course digital learning, including reviews and assessments
Pass all requirements and evaluations for Practical Application Sessions 1–7
Pass the Assistant Instructor final exam
facts: SSI Divemaster and Enriched Air Nitrox 40 (or equivalents)
courses.inc: All learning materials, instructor time and breathing gases (for student and instructor).

courses.lede: Teach the specialties you love.
body: There are three routes to becoming a Specialty Instructor: complete the Specialty Instructor Seminar for the course; co-teach at least one complete course and have 10 logged dives in that specialty; or apply with proof of at least 20 logged dives in the specialty (or proof of experience for non-diving specialties).
Each Specialty Instructor course is £275, including use of the dive centre, instructor time and breathing gases where needed.
courses.list_title: We can qualify you to teach

courses.lede: Welcome to the world of the SSI freediving professional.
body: Snorkelling is a fantastic way to see the underwater world. As an SSI Snorkel Instructor you'll be able to teach the SSI Snorkel Diver course and guide snorkellers on open water excursions.
courses.inc: All learning materials, equipment, instructor time and 1 day of in-water training. Extra days are chargeable.
